notes: The accent picker's square was lit from the bottom edge, and only one of its corners was round. The black shade overlay had its transparency the wrong way up, so value ran dark-to-light downward instead of light-to-dark; and the two colour overlays painted straight over the container's rounded corners, because ClipsDescendants clips to the rectangle and not to the UICorner shape - the one round corner you could see was the parent peeking out past a square overlay. Both overlays now carry the same radius, and the gradient runs the right way up. Downgrading from 66 is unchanged and included.
